name: CA-38
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 8-point Democratic partisan lean after redistricting
Solis's large fundraising edge and outside support
Prediction markets price a Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: The fundamentals point clearly Democratic: the post-redistricting seat leans D by 8 points, Hilda Solis has raised over $1 million with outside backing while Pedro Casas reports no fundraising, and Polymarket prices a Democratic win at 98%. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict that, the forecast stays at a roughly 20-point Democratic margin.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a closer race, or a surge in Republican fundraising, would be the first sign this is competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 38th District is an open seat after redistricting, and it leans Democratic by about 8 points on the partisan baseline. Hilda Solis, a well-known local Democrat, enters with a clear financial advantage, having raised over $1 million and drawn outside support, while Republican Pedro Casas has reported no fundraising activity.

With no public polls or expert ratings for the race, the forecast rests on fundamentals and market pricing, both of which point strongly to Solis. The expected margin is around 20 points, though uncertainty is somewhat elevated because the seat has no incumbent and polling is absent.
